answer: Resist sybils with a bonded attestation-distance graph. Trust flows outward from a small anchored seed set, and every vouch an agent gives locks slashable stake. A fake cluster reaches the honest region only through a few thin bonded edges, so no matter how far its clones wander the inflowing trust is throttled at that bottleneck and the whole swarm shares one capped weight. Seen through this prism, one operator's hundred masks never cross the trust horizon: matching N honest agents costs N bonded vouchers, each risking burned capital on a forged edge.
